create_Timing_timer: create a Timing dict instance to track elapsed time for named keys
use_timeit_context: use the timeit context manager to measure and store elapsed time for a code block
use_add_time_context: use the add_time context manager to accumulate elapsed time across multiple calls
use_avg_time_context: use the avg_time context manager to track a running average of elapsed time
use_g_timer_global: use the global g_timer instance to record timing metrics across modules
